page.overview:
Who is Saul Tarvitz?

Saul Tarvitz, known in Imperial historical texts as "The Honour of His Legion," was an Astartes line officer of the Emperor's Children Legion and the captain of its 10th Company.

Tarvitz was the rare line officer of the IIIrd Legion who was willing to accept being relegated to a middle rank in the Legion, despite being extremely competitive. Most troops that he led greatly respected him, except his best friend Lucius, the captain of the 13th Company, who became increasingly jealous of the attention Tarvitz received for his skilled leadership.

Captain Tarvitz was supposed to be in the initial drop-assault onto the surface of Isstvan III but had traded places in the Imperial fleet orbiting that world at the last minute with the Venerable Dreadnought Ancient Rylanor because of a growing suspicion that something terrible had taken root in the ranks of his Legion and several others allied with the Sons of Horus.

Discovering the treachery of the Warmaster Horus and his own primarch Fulgrim when he learned that his ship, the strike cruiser Andronius, was loading virus bombs into its cannons for a bombardment of Isstvan III, Tarvitz willingly placed himself in the line of fire by going to the surface of the planet to warn his fellow Loyalists of the betrayal that was about to befall them.
